design.statistic: Welch t of stratum-vs-complement mean out-of-fold residual (target_censored - shipped blend prediction)

age.justification: 20 / 22 / 23.5 are the HS-signing, college-draft and 'old for the upper minors' conventions

age_rel_level.justification: -2 / -0.5 / +1 years vs the level's typical age: very young, young, on time, old

level.justification: the level ladder itself; DSL folded into CPX for n

acq.justification: acquisition cohort: international amateur / college draft / high-school draft

fv.justification: consensus FV tiers 35-/40/45/50+, the industry's own grade bins

pick.justification: draft rounds: top 10, rest of round 1 plus comp, rounds 2-3, day 2/3

bonus.justification: signing bonus among rows that report one; no established threshold

role.justification: starter vs reliever, the single biggest pitcher role split

era_sign.justification: better / worse than the level median

peak_bb_rel.justification: best-season walk rate, no established threshold
